releases.name: agentic-uat v1.1.0 — Portable coverage traceability and bilingual documentation
releases.body:
# agentic-uat v1.1.0 — Portable coverage traceability and complete bilingual documentation

## Highlights

- **Portable coverage governance**: optional Cell/Case profiles link business conditions to executable cases with source-bound constraints, risk-bounded mandatory cells, implicit singleton mappings for independent ACs, and derived case counts rather than fixed targets.
- **Deterministic execution and reverification**: Run master records, Run-Case assertion details, and Case status tables. Latest FULL runs form the baseline; partial failures override earlier passes, partial passes cannot flip a case green, and REVERIFY preserves Case identity through `reverify_of`.
- **Evidence and report integrity**: primary/secondary assertion aggregation, complete MIXED cause sets, planned-reference evidence classification, AC/Case dual-set reporting, and a clean separation between evidence completeness and the `CLOSED` lifecycle outcome.
- **Portability fixtures**: repayment, permission governance, user order handling, a nine-case execution fixture, and fifteen executable negative cases.
- **Complete bilingual README**: English and Chinese are independently readable full guides, including workflow, coverage model, carriers, design tenets, all three pinned installation routes, versions, and license.

Bundle version: **1.1.0**. Included skills: acceptance-contract-governance **1.9.0**, simulated-user-acceptance **3.9.0**.

## Install

### HTTP catalog

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "skills": ["https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/linjz3376/agentic-uat@v1.1.0/catalog/"]
}
```

### npm

```sh
npm i -g @linjz/agentic-uat@1.1.0
```

### Git

```sh
git clone --branch v1.1.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/linjz3376/agentic-uat
```

See [README.md](https://github.com/linjz3376/agentic-uat/blob/v1.1.0/README.md) for platform-specific skill copying instructions and all usage details.

## Validation

- Main regression: **300/300 PASS**
- Coverage model and fixtures: **218/218 PASS**
- Bilingual documentation audit: **57/57 PASS**
- Router: train **36/36**, held-out **16/16**
- Markdown: **48 files, 150 tables, 54 code fences passed**
- npm dry-run: **100 files**, all required fixtures and catalog files included
- Independent architecture, portability, execution-model, English-reading, and Chinese-reading reviews closed

## 中文摘要

本版新增可移植的组合覆盖治理：以 Cell/Case 连接业务条件与执行子用例，以 Run 主表、Run-Case 断言明细和 Case 状态表跟踪执行及复验。部分失败会覆盖旧通过，部分通过不能整体翻绿；混合判定保留完整原因集合，计划引用决定证据归格，证据完整性不再额外阻止保底报告或 CLOSED。

随附履约还款、权限治理、用户办单三个设计夹具、一个执行夹具和十五个负例。README 已重构为中英文各自可独立阅读的完整文档，三种安装方式均固定到 v1.1.0。

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/linjz3376/agentic-uat
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@linjz/agentic-uat
- Catalog: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/linjz3376/agentic-uat@v1.1.0/catalog/index.json

releases.name: agentic-uat v1.0.0 — AI-agent-driven UAT skill pair
releases.body:
# agentic-uat v1.0.0 — first stable release

Agentic UAT skill pair: generate acceptance-contract test task books, then execute them as simulated users.

## What's inside

Two carrier-neutral skills:

- **acceptance-contract-governance** — turns "test feature X" into a self-contained executable instruction document (AC-ID acceptance tables, scenario matrices, coverage reconciliation). Govern mode: contract health checks, 29119-3 split, pollution cleanup.
- **simulated-user-acceptance** — executes task books as real users: persona-based end-to-end journeys, UI-primary evidence, bounded interaction control flow (fresh-perception contract, progress-proof retry ladder), blocked-attribution auditing (UNREACHABLE/OMITTED/DEFERRED/N-A), three-state reporting, machine-computed coverage.

## Install (three equivalent routes)

```jsonc
// Route A — HTTP catalog, zero copy
{ "skills": ["https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/linjz3376/agentic-uat@v1/catalog/"] }
```

```bash
# Route B — npm
npm i -g @linjz/agentic-uat && cp -r "$(npm root -g)/@linjz/agentic-uat/skills/*" ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```bash
# Route C — git
git clone https://github.com/linjz3376/agentic-uat
```

Compatible with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot, OpenClaw, Hermes, WorkBuddy and any agent runtime that reads SKILL.md format.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/linjz3376/agentic-uat
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@linjz/agentic-uat
- Related: [opencode-qqbot](https://github.com/linjz3376/opencode-qqbot) — production QQ gateway built and validated with this skill pair
